text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good physical and mental health; 2. Students applying for the undergraduate program must have a high school diploma or equivalent, have excellent academic performance, be at least 18 years old and no more than 25 years old. Applicants for the master's program must hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent, have excellent academic performance, be at least 18 years old and no more than 40 years old. Students applying for the doctoral program must hold a master's degree or equivalent qualifications, be at least 18 years old, have excellent academic performance, and not exceed 50 years old. (Age calculation is based on May 15, 2025).
